admission.service: Internal Medicine, transferred to MICU on day 3
admission.presenting_complaint: 1-week productive cough, fevers to 39.5°C, progressive dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain (worse on left).
admission.hpi_summary: Previously healthy 29M presented to ED with 1 week of cough, fever, and worsening pleuritic left-sided chest pain. ED CXR (study _000) showed bilateral pleural effusions, larger on the left with a loculated air-containing component concerning for complicated parapneumonic effusion / early empyema with bronchopleural communication. Admitted for IV antibiotics and IR-guided drainage. Course complicated on day 3 by iatrogenic right pneumothorax with subcutaneous emphysema during attempted right-sided pigtail placement; transferred to MICU.

active_problems: Severe community-acquired pneumonia, organism not yet identified (cultures pending).
Complicated parapneumonic effusion / early empyema, bilateral, left > right.
Loculated left hydropneumothorax — concern for bronchopleural fistula on the left.
Iatrogenic right pneumothorax with subcutaneous emphysema, day 3, post attempted right pigtail placement.
Acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, on supplemental O2.

medications.name: metronidazole
medications.indication: added day 2 for anaerobic coverage given empyema

procedures.result: Drained ~700 mL turbid fluid; cultures and cytology sent. Catheter to suction.

procedures.complications: Iatrogenic right pneumothorax with subcutaneous emphysema along the right lateral chest wall and axilla. Documented on post-procedure CXR (study _003).

procedures.procedure: Right tube thoracostomy (28 Fr) by thoracic surgery
procedures.result: Placed at bedside in the MICU for persistent right pneumothorax with ongoing air leak. Tube to -20 cmH2O suction. Continuous air leak noted.

indwelling_devices_as_of_record: Left pleural pigtail catheter (12 Fr), placed day 3, to suction.
Right tube thoracostomy (28 Fr), placed day 4, to suction, continuous air leak.
Right peripheral IV; left forearm IV.
